laws.title: Hate Crime Laws
laws.subtitle: K.S.A. §Criminal Code — Bias-motivated crime laws
laws.fullDescription: Kansas has hate crime sentencing enhancements.
laws.penalty: Hate crime enhancement or separate charge: sentencing enhancement.
laws.exceptions: Protected speech expressing bias without accompanying criminal conduct is constitutionally protected.

quiz.q: Does Kansas have hate crime laws?
quiz.explanation: Kansas: Hate crime enhancements apply.

laws.title: Domestic Violence Laws & Protections
laws.subtitle: K.S.A. §Domestic Violence Act — Domestic Violence Act
laws.fullDescription: Kansas: Comprehensive DV protections including protective orders.
laws.penalty: Violation of DV protective order: misdemeanor to felony..
laws.exceptions: Mutual protective orders may be issued in some circumstances.

quiz.q: Does Kansas have mandatory arrest policies for domestic violence?
quiz.explanation: Kansas: DV protective orders and protections available.

laws.title: Stalking & Cyberstalking Laws
laws.subtitle: K.S.A. §Criminal Code — Stalking prohibition
laws.fullDescription: Kansas prohibits stalking — repeated non-consensual contact causing substantial distress. Stalking prohibited; cyberstalking covered.
laws.penalty: First-degree stalking: felony. Second-degree: misdemeanor.
laws.exceptions: Lawful investigations by law enforcement are not considered stalking.

quiz.q: Is cyberstalking (electronic harassment) covered by Kansas's stalking law?
quiz.explanation: Kansas's stalking law covers cyberstalking through electronic means.

laws.title: Consumer Data Privacy Law
laws.subtitle: K.S.A. §Privacy Act — Breach notification law
laws.fullDescription: Kansas: Data breach notification required.
laws.penalty: Data breach notification: civil fines.
laws.exceptions: Small businesses may have reduced obligations under some state laws.

quiz.q: Does Kansas have a comprehensive consumer data privacy law?
quiz.explanation: Kansas: Breach notification rules only.

laws.title: Social Media Age Verification
laws.subtitle: K.S.A. §N/A — No state law
laws.fullDescription: Kansas: No social media age verification law.
laws.penalty: N/A — enforcement mechanisms vary.
laws.exceptions: Federal platforms regulation may preempt state laws.

quiz.q: Does Kansas require age verification for social media?
quiz.explanation: Kansas: No social media age verification law.

laws.title: Environmental Regulations
laws.subtitle: K.S.A. §Environmental Code — Environmental protection
laws.fullDescription: Kansas: State env agency enforces air, water, waste rules.
laws.penalty: Environmental violations: civil fines up to $25000/day; criminal penalties for willful violations.
laws.exceptions: Some agricultural and industrial uses have specific permitting pathways.

quiz.q: Which agency enforces environmental laws in Kansas?
quiz.explanation: Kansas's state environmental agency works alongside the EPA to enforce environmental laws.

laws.title: Renewable Energy Standards
laws.subtitle: K.S.A. §Energy Code — Renewable Portfolio Standard (RPS)
laws.fullDescription: Kansas: Kansas has an RPS of 15% renewables by 2019 (already exceeded — Kansas produces large amounts of wind energy).
laws.penalty: N/A — this is a policy/utility requirement, not a criminal law.
laws.exceptions: Utilities that miss RPS targets may pay alternative compliance payments.

quiz.q: Does Kansas have a Renewable Portfolio Standard (RPS)?
quiz.explanation: Kansas: Kansas exceeded its RPS; it is a major wind energy producer.

laws.title: Plastic Bag Laws
laws.subtitle: K.S.A. §N/A — No statewide law
laws.fullDescription: Kansas: No statewide plastic bag law.
laws.penalty: Retailer violations: N/A.
laws.exceptions: Bags for meat, produce, or bulk items are often exempt.

quiz.q: Does Kansas have a statewide plastic bag ban or fee?
quiz.explanation: Kansas: No statewide plastic bag law.

laws.title: Bottle Deposit Law
laws.subtitle: K.S.A. §N/A — Bottle bill status
laws.fullDescription: Kansas: No bottle deposit program.
laws.penalty: Retailers not accepting returns may face fines.
laws.exceptions: Some municipal redemption centers supplement mandatory deposit systems.

quiz.q: Does Kansas have a bottle deposit/redemption law?
quiz.explanation: Kansas: No bottle deposit.

laws.title: Animal Cruelty Laws
laws.subtitle: K.S.A. §Criminal Code — Animal cruelty prohibition
laws.fullDescription: Kansas prohibits cruelty to animals including torture, beating, neglect, and fighting. Animal cruelty is a felony; neglect is a misdemeanor.
laws.penalty: Intentional cruelty: felony (up to 5 years). Neglect: misdemeanor.
laws.exceptions: Lawful hunting, fishing, pest control, and veterinary procedures are exempt.

quiz.q: What is the maximum penalty for intentional animal cruelty in Kansas?
quiz.explanation: Kansas: Intentional animal cruelty is punishable by felony (up to 5 years).

laws.title: Exotic Pet Ownership
laws.subtitle: K.S.A. §Wildlife Code — Exotic and wild animal ownership
laws.fullDescription: Kansas: Dangerous exotic animals generally prohibited as pets.
laws.penalty: Unlawful possession of prohibited animal: misdemeanor or felony; animal seizure..
laws.exceptions: Licensed zoos, wildlife rehabilitators, and research institutions may keep otherwise prohibited animals.

quiz.q: Are large exotic cats (lions, tigers) legal as pets in Kansas?
quiz.explanation: Kansas: Large exotic cats banned as pets.

laws.title: Fireworks Laws
laws.subtitle: K.S.A. §Fire Safety Code — Consumer fireworks regulations
laws.fullDescription: Kansas: Consumer fireworks regulated.
laws.penalty: Fireworks violation: $500–$2000 fines plus liability for fire damage.
laws.exceptions: Licensed pyrotechnic operators may use professional-grade fireworks at permitted events.

quiz.q: Are consumer aerial fireworks legal in Kansas?
quiz.explanation: Kansas: Safe-and-sane fireworks allowed with local restrictions.

laws.title: Gambling Laws
laws.subtitle: K.S.A. §Gaming Code — Gambling regulations
laws.fullDescription: Kansas: Kansas has commercial casinos (4 state-owned facilities) and tribal gaming. Sports betting legalized 2022.
laws.penalty: Illegal gambling: Illegal gambling: misdemeanor..
laws.exceptions: Charitable gaming (bingo, pull tabs) for nonprofits typically permitted with license.

quiz.q: Are commercial casinos legal in Kansas?
quiz.explanation: Kansas: Kansas has state-owned casinos and legal sports betting.

laws.title: Net Neutrality (State Level)
laws.subtitle: K.S.A. §N/A — Internet regulation
laws.fullDescription: Kansas: No state net neutrality law.
laws.penalty: N/A — enforcement varies by state.
laws.exceptions: Federal FCC rules may preempt conflicting state laws.

quiz.q: Does Kansas have a state net neutrality law?
quiz.explanation: Kansas: No state net neutrality law.

laws.title: Right to Repair Laws
laws.subtitle: K.S.A. §N/A — Consumer right to repair
laws.fullDescription: Kansas: No right-to-repair law.
laws.penalty: N/A — this defines consumer rights.
laws.exceptions: Some manufacturers have voluntarily expanded repair access independent of state laws.

quiz.q: Does Kansas have a right-to-repair law?
quiz.explanation: Kansas: No right-to-repair law.

laws.title: LGBTQ+ Employment Protections
laws.subtitle: K.S.A. §Civil Rights Code — Sexual orientation and gender identity protections
laws.fullDescription: Kansas: LGBTQ+ workers rely on federal Bostock protections.
laws.penalty: Employment discrimination based on LGBTQ+ status: same remedies as other protected classes.
laws.exceptions: The federal Bostock v. Clayton County (2020) ruling extended Title VII to cover LGBTQ+ workers nationwide.

quiz.q: Are LGBTQ+ workers explicitly protected by Kansas state law?
quiz.explanation: Kansas: Federal Bostock protections apply; no explicit state LGBTQ+ employment law.
